```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE)
library(ggplot2)
library(tidyverse)
```
```{r}
```

```{r}
DF <-read.csv("/Users/mari/Desktop/mitox/data/modelling_AE-with-mics_baseline.csv")
```
```{r}
DF <-DF %>%
  mutate(new.estimate=ifelse(estimate>0,log(estimate),log(abs(estimate))*-1))
```

```{r}
ggplot(data=DF,aes(x=new.estimate, y=-log10(p.value))) + geom_point()+theme_bw()+labs(x="log(estimate"))
```
